commit.message: governance: ratify the four-lane Mac focus reset

intent: Ratify and re-test the resulting post-crash governance state after an atomic owner-file transition established exactly four active Mac programs: Fleet advancement, the SADHANA ten-day program, RSI Lab via Meghadharma, and the Sublimation Forge. Record the packet validator's bootstrap limitation explicitly: a newly introduced authorizing track cannot preflight the commit that introduces it, while a removed authorizing track cannot close out that same commit.

honest_blockers: Commit 17e04edea2280cc03a237e8221e7f1b09f16d78f necessarily preceded this ratification packet because Session Entry requires its authorizing track to exist at both clean preflight and changed closeout; the atomic replacement has no such common track.
The portfolio reset does not prove any executor, daemon, remote host, participant journey, or production adapter is live.
Fleet Hub, Mission Control, and HELM require their own verified implementation evidence before the Fleet prototype blocker can close.
SADHANA still requires the preserved truth-fix delta to land and participant-safe program evidence to be produced.
RSI exact-code synchronization does not prove research quality; bounded Meghadharma campaign receipts remain required.
Sublimation Forge remains offline-only until its held-out pilot and kill-switch evidence pass separate review.
interface_mismatches: The previous portfolio encoded ten unrelated active lanes, while the operator now authorizes only four Mac build programs; the transition is verified by whole-state gates rather than represented as a false pre-transition admission.
Mission Control and HELM were formerly represented as independent governance tracks, but are now deliverables inside Fleet advancement rather than additional standing slots.
Historical track detail must remain inspectable even though those entries no longer confer active build authority.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the ratification commit, then separately revert 17e04edea2280cc03a237e8221e7f1b09f16d78f if the operator rejects the four-lane focus reset. Neither commit starts, stops, deploys, spends, contacts humans, or mutates remote runtime state.
